messages:
tanya.procure: FYI FluxMetric sent pilot invoice + a strange clause: pilot credits are "earned" only against overage, not toward committed tiers. Attached their invoice PDF. Can finance/billing weigh in?

 evan.finance: that wording undermines our negotiating position. If credits don't count for tiering we lose leverage to hit discounts. paste invoice snippet?

 tanya.procure: snippet:
 ```
 Invoice #A-334
 - Pilot ingest (GB): 500 @ $0.03 = $15.00
 - Event transforms (10k): 12 @ $4.50 = $54.00
 - Pilot credit applied: -$200.00
 Net due: -$131.00
 ```
 They applied credit on invoice but T&Cs say credits "apply to invoice charges only and do not reduce committed tier thresholds."

 megan.billing: operationally acceptable only if credits convert on amendment. Otherwise accounting treats them as one-off discounts; they won't reduce committed liability. Also VAT treatment could differ. We'll need a credit memo example showing conversion.

 riley.sales: propose asks to vendor: 1) permit conversion of up to 80% of pilot credits into year-1 committed dollar-for-dollar upon executed amendment within 30 days; 2) waive onboarding/setup for pilot; 3) supply SOC2 attestation within 45 days or limit pilot to non-PII flows.

 evan.finance: add an audit right: we can verify pilot usage and that converted credits match unused credit balance. Also require vendor to issue a single credit memo when conversion happens. Include a clause: "converted credits shall be treated as prepayments and reduce committed fees dollar-for-dollar."

 secbot: FluxMetric uploaded terms v1.2: https://fluxmetric.example.com/terms/2026-04-02 (doc)

 tanya.procure: i'll send the three asks now. payment hold: we release any net negative invoice (they owe us) but will withhold payment of disputed onboarding fees until corrected invoice is provided. Agreed?

 megan.billing: agreed. I'll run the accounting impact if conversion is allowed. Tagging tax for VAT check after vendor confirms conversion form.

 riley.sales: I'll push rep for 80% + 30-day amendment window. If they push back, accept 60% + SLA credits.

 tanya.procure: thanks all. i'll post vendor reply and the draft amendment wording here when I have it.
